title: Kumarbhag Paharia Language (KMJ) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status ...
text: Kumarbhag Paharia is a stable indigenous language of India. It belongs to the Dravidian language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
